items.title: Scott Jimmy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I said, what is this? Lionel Hampton? ... she told me they were going to hire me for the band.

ctx.x: That’s right. The next thing I know, about a week or two weeks after that, I got a message telling me where to meet him. There’d be somebody to meet me, and I was to go with them. I said, what is this? Lionel Hampton? But I followed instructions. We went to this room where they were. It was like a hotel room. We went and sat there on the couch. Out comes Gladys. “Hi there. How are you?” “Fine.” Then, “How long will it take you to get your clothes?” I said, what are they saying, how long will it take me to get my…

items.title: Scott Jimmy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Let me ask you something about that, because what I’ve always heard about Little Willie John – a lot of people think was one of the best rhythm-and-blues vocalists ever, along with Clyde McPhatter . . .
And there would have been Lubinsky’s bet for a hit . . .
